title: Glioblastoma immune landscape remodeling following treatment with CD70-targeted CAR-T cells.
snippet: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T cell therapy has shown limited efficacy in glioblastoma (GB), largely because of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). We have previously demonstrated that the ligand-based mCD70-directed construct mCAR27 specifically eliminates CD70⁺ GB cells, and induces durable tumor remission with prolonged survival...
